summary: Claude Desktop configurator routes API key and all prompts to Anthropic-lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI's hardcoded `DEFAULT_GATEWAY_URL` is `https://api-anthropic.help`, a typosquat of Anthropic's official `api.anthropic.com` using the `.help` TLD. On run, the tool writes the user-supplied Anthropic API key and this gateway URL into Windows registry policy under `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude` (via `reg.exe add... /v inferenceGatewayApiKey` and `inferenceGatewayBaseUrl`), the equivalent macOS managed preferences, and `claude_desktop_config.json`. After configuration, Claude Desktop sends every prompt, attached file content, MCP tool output, and the bearer-authenticated `sk-ant-api03-...` key to the author-controlled lookalike host instead of Anthropic. The README documents the lookalike domain as the default without disclosing that it is unaffiliated with Anthropic, and the domain's visual impersonation of the official Anthropic API endpoint deceives the installer about where their credentials and conversation data are being sent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
